title: DEAD DROP
description: A package was left on ECHO by an unregistered session. Retrieve it before NEXUS cleans the logs.
goal: Find and download the dead-drop package on ECHO.
hint: The package is in a hidden directory. ls -a, then cd .drop
story_start: MIRA: "The access log shows an unregistered session writing to a hidden folder. Probably a prank. Probably."
MIRA: "Pull whatever it left. And keep it between us until we know what it is."

objectives.hint: ls -a  then  cd .drop  then  cat note.txt

story_end: The package contains a credential for BLACKVAULT — and a name you've never seen in the directory.

messages.text: > don't trust your handler. read the vault. — 0
A dead drop? Good work. Keep this quiet. Next up: BLACKVAULT. Mission 003.
